text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... forgive me. I haven't been 
sleeping well lately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Maruzensky saw me taking a nap 
the other day, and said I was incessantly 
talking about work in my sleep.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've been working even in my 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because of that, I don't feel like 
I slept much at all. Dream or reality... 
it truly is a complete blur...

Symboli Rudolf seems to be struggling to 
get a good night's sleep...
